sloka: नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा पापो वा यदि वा शुभ: ।यासां स्त्रीणां प्रियो भर्ता तासां लोका महोदया: ॥ २.११७.२१॥
transliteration: nagarastho vanastho vā pāpo vā yadi vā śubha: ।yāsāṁ strīṇāṁ priyo bhartā tāsāṁ lokā mahodayā: ॥ 2.117.21॥

translations.english: O noble Sita, by the grace of heaven you are following Rama, forsaking your kinsmen and wealth and confining yourself to the forest.
